summary: Iteration 8 - Settings (Sub-sectors, Positions, Activities) and Companies Module Testing: 26/28 backend tests passed (93%). All frontend features verified working: Settings page with 8 tabs including new Alt Sektorlar, Vəzifələr, Fəaliyyətlər tabs. Companies page with multi-tab modal (Şirkət, Sahibkar, Əlaqədar şəxs, Müqavilə, Ödəniş). File upload working.

minor.issue: New fields (voen, sub_sector, region, employee_count) are not included in CompanyCreate Pydantic model. Fields are sent from frontend but not returned in response. Data may be stored in MongoDB but not validated/returned by API.
Same issue - CompanyUpdate model doesn't include voen, sub_sector, region, employee_count fields

action_items: Update CompanyCreate and CompanyUpdate Pydantic models in server.py to include: voen, sub_sector, region, employee_count fields
These fields are used in frontend Companies.jsx but backend models don't define them
critical_code_review_comments: Backend Pydantic models (CompanyCreate, CompanyUpdate) are missing new fields that frontend sends: voen, sub_sector, region, employee_count. While MongoDB stores them, the API doesn't validate or return them properly.
seed_data_creation: Test sectors, positions, activities created and cleaned up during tests. Existing data in DB: 7 sectors (Qeyri qida, İnşaat, Təhsil, Qida, İKT, Mətbəə), 6 default positions, 6 default activities.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings page has 8 tabs. New tabs (Alt Sektorlar, Vəzifələr, Fəaliyyətlər) are fully functional. Companies page has multi-tab modal with all fields. Key issue: Backend Pydantic models need to be updated to include voen, sub_sector, region, employee_count fields. The /api/options/all endpoint correctly returns sub_sectors (as dict), positions, activities, education_levels. File upload at /api/upload works. All UI is in Azerbaijani language.

settings_sub_sectors_tab.details: Alt Sektorlar tab shows parent sector dropdown and sub-sector name input. Create, update, delete operations work. Sub-sectors appear in /api/options/all under their parent sector.

settings_positions_tab.details: Vəzifələr tab shows position name input and list of positions. Create and delete operations work. Positions appear in /api/options/all and in company form Vəzifə dropdown.

settings_activities_tab.details: Fəaliyyətlər tab shows activity name input and list of activities. Create and delete operations work. Activities appear in /api/options/all and in company form 'Qatılmaq istədiyi fəaliyyətlər' section.

companies_modal_tabs.details: Company modal has 6 tabs: Şirkət (company info), Sahibkar (owner info with multiple owners support), Əlaqədar şəxs (contact person), Müqavilə (contracts with multiple contracts support), Ödəniş (payment), Əlavə (custom fields).

companies_sub_sector_dropdown.details: Alt sektor dropdown is dependent on Sektor selection. Shows 'Alt sektor yoxdur' when no sub-sectors exist for selected sector.

file_upload.details: POST /api/upload accepts file and returns {url, filename, stored_name}. Logo and bank files upload buttons present in company form.

options_all_endpoint.details: /api/options/all returns sub_sectors (dict), positions (list), activities (list), education_levels (list) along with existing fields.
